scenarios.title: A｜正常求助
scenarios.setting: 玩家正在处理一个任务，但有一步不知道怎么操作。

turns.text: Hey, do you have a minute? I could use some help with this.

turns.prompt: 你想请同事指导自己不熟悉的文件操作，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you show me how to update this file?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me how to update this file?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’m not sure how to do this part. Could you take a look?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure how to do this part. Could you take a look?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Have you done this before? I could use some help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Have you done this before? I could use some help.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Could you walk me through this when you have a minute?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you walk me through this when you have a minute?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can you teach me how to do this work?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me how to update this file?
feedback.explanation: “teach me”能请求指导，但范围较大；“show me how to …”更适合某项具体操作。

turns.text: Sure. Open the project folder first, and I’ll show you.

turns.prompt: 你想跟随同事指导，核对文件操作的下一步，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Is this the right folder?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Is this the right folder?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Got it. What do I do next?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. What do I do next?
feedback.explanation: “what do I do”确认具体操作或下一步，让对方给出可执行的指导。

choices.text: Could you show me once, and then I’ll try it myself?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me once, and then I’ll try it myself?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Exactly. Then just upload the new version here.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for helping me out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for helping me out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, I think I can handle it from here. Thanks!

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I think I can handle it from here. Thanks!
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

scenarios.title: B｜解释自己遇到的问题
scenarios.setting: 在“向同事请求帮助”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“解释自己遇到的问题”。

turns.text: You said you were having trouble with the task?

turns.prompt: 关于「向同事请求帮助」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah. I can open the file, but I can’t save my changes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I can open the file, but I can’t save my changes.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Everything works until I try to upload the new version.

feedback.naturalExpression: Everything works until I try to upload the new version.
feedback.explanation: 说明其他步骤正常，直到上传新版本才出错，能帮助缩小故障范围。

choices.text: I keep getting an error when I try to submit it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I keep getting an error when I try to submit it.
feedback.explanation: “an error”指报错提示；说明出现在哪一步，有助于对方排查。

choices.text: I’ve tried restarting the program, but that didn’t help.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve tried restarting the program, but that didn’t help.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: It always has an error when I submit.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I can open the file, but I can’t save my changes.
feedback.explanation: 系统报错可说“I get an error when I submit it”；明确提交对象和报错步骤，更便于排查。

turns.text: What does the error message say?

turns.prompt: 你想告诉同事系统报错的具体内容，会怎么说？

choices.text: It says I don’t have permission to edit the file.

feedback.naturalExpression: It says I don’t have permission to edit the file.
feedback.explanation: “it says”引用屏幕、通知或记录上的内容，便于一起核对信息来源。

choices.text: It says “Access denied.” I’m not sure why.

feedback.naturalExpression: It says “Access denied.” I’m not sure why.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: I’m not sure what it means. Could you take a look?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure what it means. Could you take a look?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: I think you haven’t been added to the project folder yet.

turns.prompt: 你想确认应该找谁开通所需权限，会怎么说？

choices.text: Ah, that would explain it. Who should I ask for access?

feedback.naturalExpression: Ah, that would explain it. Who should I ask for access?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Could you add me, or should I contact someone else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you add me, or should I contact someone else?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Okay, I thought I was doing something wrong.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I thought I was doing something wrong.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

scenarios.title: C｜对方暂时没时间
scenarios.setting: 在“向同事请求帮助”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方暂时没时间”。

turns.text: Hey, could you help me with something when you have a minute?
I’m in the middle of something right now. Can it wait?

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure, no problem. Just let me know when you’re free.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure, no problem. Just let me know when you’re free.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Of course. It’s not urgent.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. It’s not urgent.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yeah, that’s fine. I can work on something else for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s fine. I can work on something else for now.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: No worries. Would later this afternoon work?

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. Would later this afternoon work?
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Okay, I wait you finish.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure, no problem. Just let me know when you’re free.
feedback.explanation: 等某人做完用“wait for you to finish”；“wait”不能直接接“you finish”。

turns.text: I should be free after lunch.

turns.prompt: 关于「向同事请求帮助」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll check back with you then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll check back with you then.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sounds good. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll send you the details first so you can look at them later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll send you the details first so you can look at them later.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
